title: Research on circRNA–miRNA Binding Prediction Featured on EurekAlert!
body: Juseong Kim, Sanghun Sel, and Prof. Giltae Song developed circMAC, an AI-based framework for predicting microRNA binding sites on full-length circular RNA isoforms. Their research, published in Briefings in Bioinformatics, was featured on EurekAlert!, highlighting advances in RNA interaction prediction.
Congratulations to Juseong Kim and Sanghun Sel on their outstanding research achievement!

title: Kibeom's paper accepted in Briefings in Bioinformatics

body.text: Our paper, titled "
Therapeutic Gene Target Prediction Using Novel Deep Hypergraph Representation Learning"
, was accepted for publication in
Briefings in Bioinformatics
in January 2025.
Congratulations to Kibeom (Ph.D. student), Juseong (Ph.D. student), and Minwook (currently with Samsung Global Technology Research)!

title: Groundbreaking Study on Structural Variations in Human Genomes Published in Cell

body.text: We are excited to announce the publication of our international collaboration with Dr. Bo Zhou and Prof. Alex Urban from Stanford University. The research article, titled
'Detection and Analysis of Complex Structural Variation in Human Genomes Across Populations and in the Brains of Donors with Psychiatric Disorders,'
has been published in
Cell
. Congratulations to Dr. Bo Zhou and Prof. Alex Urban on this remarkable achievement!
A special thanks to Taeyoung Kim (currently with 예탁결제원) and Minsu Kim (an MS student) for their dedication and hard work in this collaboration.

title: Our paper published in PLoS ONE

body.text: Paper titled as "Fuzzy clustering of 24-2 visual field patterns can detect glaucoma progression" was published in PLoS ONE. This is an outcome of the collaboration with Prof. Jiwoong Lee in the Department of Ophthalmology at Pusan National University Hospital.
Thanks for your hard work to Seungtae Yoo (now at DB Insurance Co.) and Jiwon Lee (undergraduate student) !!

title: Dohyeon's paper was accepted in Bioinformatics (Impact factor: 6.937)

Dohyeon is employed in Koscom (코스콤) after finishing his master degree.
Congratulations, Dohyeon!

title: Gwangho's paper is published in PLoS ONE. Congratulations, Gwangho !!

body.text: Gwangho's paper titled as "Predicting aptamer sequences that interact with target proteins using an aptamer-protein interaction classifier and a Monte Carlo tree search approach" is published in PLoS ONE. Congratulations, Gwangho !!
Gwangho is employed in LG AI Research (LG AI연구원).

title: Inhyuk's abstract is accepted for an oral presentation in ISMB 2021

body.text: Inhyuk's abstract is accepted for an oral presentation in ISMB 2021. He will give a talk for 20 minutes about CNN models for determining copy number variations in cancer genomes using short read sequencing data only. Inhyuk is employed in KRX (한국거래소). Congratulations, Inhyuk!

title: Our paper is published in BMC Oral Health

body.text: Our paper titled "Authentication of differential gene experession in oral squamous cell carcinoma using machine learning applications" is published in BMC Oral Health. Congratulations, Rian!

title: My laboratory received a grant from National Research Foundation of Korea

body.text: My laboratory received a grant from National Research Foundation of Korea for five years. The grant supports a project, "Interpretable artificial intelligence research for discovering biomarkers based on the analysis of high-volume cancer genome data and recommending new drug candidates".

title: Our CNN-Peaks paper was accepted in Scientific Reports (Impact factor: 4.011)

body.text: Dongpin Oh
, J. Seth Strattan, Junho Hur, Jose Bento, Alexander Eckehart Urban, Giltae Song

, and J. Michael Cherry, "CNN-Peaks: ChIP-Seq peak detection pipeline using convolution neural networks that imitate human visual inspection" was accepted in Scientific Reports (impact factor: 4.011, *corresponding author: Giltae Song).
Congratulations, Dongpin !!

title: IMAP paper was accepted in PLoS ONE

body.text: Giltae Song
, Jongin Lee, Juyeon Kim,
Seokwoo Kang
Hoyong Lee

, Daehong Kwon, Daehwan Lee, Gregory I. Lang, J. Michael Cherry, Jaebum Kim. "Integrative Meta-Assembly Pipeline (IMAP): Chromosome-level genome assembler combining multiple de novo assemblies" was accepted in PLoS ONE (Impact factor: 2.766).
Seokwoo Kang and Hoyong Lee contributed a lot on this paper.

title: Our paper accepted in Energy and Buildings (Impact factor: 4.457)

, Kwang Ryel Ryu, Giltae Song. "Real-time occupancy prediction in a large exhibition hall using deep learning approach" was accepted in Energy and Buildings (Impact factor: 4.457).
Congratulations, Seonghyeon and Seokwoo!!
